hebrewText: הֲ/נֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲ/לֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט

tokens.bdb: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)
broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
